definitions.explanation: A greeting used during the day, from late morning to early evening.

examples.japanese: こんにちは、お{元気|げんき}ですか。
こんにちは！{久|ひさ}しぶり！
{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}にこんにちはと{挨拶|あいさつ}した。
こんにちは。{天気|てんき}がいいですね。
{散歩|さんぽ}をしていたら、{知|し}らない{人|ひと}にこんにちはと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: While I was taking a walk, a stranger said hello to me.

notes:
こんにちは is a daytime greeting.

TIME-BASED GREETINGS:
- おはようございます (good morning)
- こんにちは (good afternoon)
- こんばんは (good evening)

WRITING NOTE:
The は is written as は (ha) but pronounced わ (wa). This is the topic particle は in the original phrase {今日|きょう}は... (As for today...).

USAGE:
- Used from late morning to early evening
- Appropriate for both formal and casual situations
